lineItems.reason: There's an invoice, but the statement doesn't show the unit was dirtier than at move-in, so some of this may be extra cleaning.
Repainting the whole unit between tenants is routine upkeep, not tenant damage, and there's no receipt for a charge over $125.
A big hole could be real damage but small nail holes are normal wear, and there's no receipt or photos for a charge over $125.
Charging full price for an 8-year-old carpet isn't fair because old carpet has lost most of its value, so a smaller prorated amount might apply.
Broken blinds are clearly damage, not wear, and charges of $125 or less don't need a receipt.

otherIssues: The statement is dated October 28, 2026, which is 27 days after the October 1 move-out, past the 21-day deadline.
No before/after photos of the unit are mentioned, and since the tenancy began after July 1, 2025, move-in photos are also required.
The repainting and wall hole charges are over $125 and have no receipts or invoices.
